study.question: Does equal fusion of a scorer with an absent target field dilute useful history ranking? Source inspection of the hash-verified r0005-query_blind incumbent shows unconditional .5*(category_score+brand_score), even when target IDs are zero. A zero embedding still receives the blind context residual and nonconstant value-dependent scores. Its candidate-supplied first-512 diagnostics report brand target missing fraction .099609375 (51/512), category fraction 0, and shared weights normalized; these are descriptive, selected-prefix observations, not full-population prevalence or evidence of harm. Baselines improve .6050036 static -> .6102261 pooled -> .6133620 target-aware. Matched count/recency features and aligned correspondence were useful locally, but joint pairing lost to support and action summaries underperformed their parent. Latest target-conditioned queries (.6185596) did not beat blind context (.6186035); the target-only reference was .6185212 and uniform context .6184616. These trajectories motivate testing field availability rather than assuming more expressive queries are needed.
study.hypothesis: When a target category or brand ID is absent, its field-specific scorer may inject generic context/history ranking into a shared target-relevance softmax. Suppressing only that scorer, while retaining both fields as history values and retaining all explicit statistics, can improve discrimination. Correct correspondence should beat the equally sized crossed-availability control; the 2x2 score denominator separates correspondence from attention temperature. The hypothesis is provisional, not an observed causal bottleneck.

study.proposed_difference: Let a_c=1[target_category>0], a_b=1[target_brand>0]. In available modes retain a_c*s_c+a_b*s_b; crossed modes retain a_b*s_c+a_c*s_b. Divide by max(a_c+a_b,1) in active mode or 2 in fixed mode, then use the unchanged history-masked softmax and unchanged category_value+brand_value. All modes explicitly preserve the original .5*(s_c+s_b) on both-known rows; both-missing scores are zero and hence history-uniform (empty histories still pool to zero). Four standalone modules form the complete binding x denominator factorial. The registered candidate is available_active; all variants have identical capacity and initialization. This tests a structural availability rule, not more tuning or added data.
predictions: Primary predeclared contrast: full-validation AUC available_active exceeds crossed_active; require positive available_fixed-minus-crossed_fixed as additional controlled support for binding across scales. Compare both available variants to the existing .6186034708944973 parent, report all differences and Logloss rather than selecting a favorable contrast after seeing results.

At fixed weights, all four variants agree exactly with parent fusion on both-positive target IDs. For single-known targets, available fusion equals the known-field score (active) or half that score (fixed); crossed fusion keeps the absent-field scorer instead. Both-missing has uniform history attention, and empty/padded histories retain zero mass.

Candidate-supplied diagnostics on the host first 512 impressions will report missing-pattern counts, nonconstant absent-target score variance, gated/parent pool and logit changes by availability, score/weight masking errors, and active/fixed pool differences. Changed pools demonstrate pathway activation only. No labels or claim of missing-group AUC are available through diagnostics.

Evaluate full validation with frozen existing slices and counts, not a hand-selected subset. First-512 diagnostics are descriptive, not confirmatory population tests. Record parameters, GPU/wall time, inference throughput/latency and memory; no equal-compute benefit is predicted.
falsifiers: At either denominator, available does not outperform crossed: field-specific availability suppression lacks robust controlled support; an active-scale-only result is an interaction requiring repetition.
Available variants fail to beat parent full-validation AUC, or any AUC gain comes with material Logloss/cost regression: this implementation does not establish practical superiority.
Scores/pools do not measurably change on target-missing, nonempty examples: proposed pathway is inactive, not evidence that missingness is irrelevant.

At identical weights, both-known fusion differs from original or empty histories produce nonzero pooled features; syntax/ownership/API checks fail; or host logits/gradients are nonfinite: implementation failure, not scientific counterevidence.
Correct-vs-crossed effects reverse or disappear under paired repetition: downgrade to unstable single-seed observation. No significance claim from initial runs.
alternative_explanations: Zero-target plus blind-context scores may supply useful generic preference information, so masking them could hurt rather than help. This is a valid scientific counterhypothesis.

The second factor changes temperature for single-known rows; score scale rather than field reliability could explain a gain. Crossed and fixed controls separate these explanations imperfectly but explicitly.
Category and brand differ; crossed gates are a deliberately wrong field binding, not randomized missingness. Retrained shared embeddings spread changes to fully observed rows.

The supplied first 512 contain 51 brand-missing but no category-missing impressions; missing-group outcomes and full-validation missing counts are unavailable in the existing receipt. Sparse/absent mechanism exposure can explain a null.

Single-seed noise, best-checkpoint selection and adaptive search can explain differences near 1e-4. Earlier joint_pair did not beat support_pair; action_attention lost to its parent; aligned_separate did not beat aligned_shared; adaptive_query did not beat blind_query. Preserve these negative trajectories.
Current memory search returned no matching agent records; this is absent indexed evidence, not a disabled source or license to invent memory. No prior runtime failure is reported.
Static snapshot as-of dates remain undocumented; this is a benchmark assumption, not verified production point-in-time evidence. Window length 128 and coarse category/brand fields limit transfer.
